temporary_memory_semantics.warning: 58,720,256 bytes is the pinned two-slot staging peak, not the total host-temporary peak. Reporting it alone as v11 peak host temporary would overstate the reduction.

failure_history_challenge.rationale: Attempts A-C did not produce admissible amplification or continuation outcomes. Their remediations were cause-aligned authorization, lifecycle, and bounded-accounting corrections sealed before attempt D; no workload, threshold, chunk size, oracle, or reported pass classification was tuned after observing a valid performance outcome.

instrumentation_challenge.interpretation: Physical bytes are canonical semantic memory touches emitted at actual execution sites and joined to CUDA events; they are not raw DRAM-controller transaction counts. Micro latency is the instrumented production-path observation and must not be presented as an uninstrumented latency estimate.

mandatory_integrated_conditions: Seal the exact integrated worker, controller, methodology, configuration, offline-gate manifest, attempt-D outcome, and all four post-micro reviews before reservation.
Reserve and run exactly one two-GPU integrated v11 transaction; disable automatic retries and fail closed on any validity predicate.

Require both integrated GPUs to be the same A100-80GB SKU. For a direct v10 latency comparison, require A100-SXM4-80GB hardware matching frozen v10; a PCIe result may not be labeled directly timing-comparable to v10.
Use the frozen seed/model revision/vLLM/PyTorch/bf16/16K/fanout-8/256-suffix/1,152-block workload and frozen 12/15/20-rps calibration without broad recalibration.
Abort if the 12-rps stability or 15-rps overload guards materially contradict frozen calibration.

Preserve allocator epochs, all 1,152 post-free transition records, raw destination lifetime and mapping evidence, the public IMPORT_ADMISSION gate witness, full pass records, and 8/8 independent continuation evidence in the integrated result.
Use non-overlapping stage intervals for reclamation, restore, Amdahl, and economic analysis; do not sum CUDA, integrity, synchronization, or fused stage timings into wall time when they overlap.
Report 143,552,512 bytes as the conservative attempt-D total host-temporary peak and 58,720,256 bytes separately as pinned staging; do not substitute the pinned value for total host temporary memory.
Treat attempt-D latency as a single instrumented PCIe-A100 observation. Do not use it alone to claim v10 latency improvement or BranchFabric hardware interest.
Keep GPU0 actively serving during restore and preserve the frozen scientific-validity AND gate, exact load/queue/SLO evidence, movement ledger, budget settlement, and complete postflight cleanup.
stop_conditions: Any post-micro independent review is FAIL.
Any sealed artifact or source hash drifts before launch.
The projected cumulative GPU use plus planning margin exceeds the configured authorization.
The allocated two-GPU hardware cannot support a scientifically comparable v10-v11 timing result.
Either sanity guard materially contradicts frozen capacity calibration.
Any required integrated scientific-validity boolean is false.

adversarial_decision.reason: The exact real-A100 state passed every correctness predicate and independently conserved to 21.000762818351625x, 39,106,884,224 fewer physical bytes than frozen v10 and safely below the explicit 25x gate. The remaining 12.000762818x avoidable work and multi-second instrumented phase walls are enough to justify one integrated serving transaction, but micro data cannot establish end-to-end hardware headroom.

scope_limit: This PASS authorizes exactly one integrated v11 transaction after immutable preflight sealing of all four PASS reviews. It does not authorize a replacement micro run, kill/recompute before integrated v11 passes, a final hardware classification, Experiment 005 execution, or FPGA implementation.
final_verdict: PASS. After adversarially discounting the PCIe/SXM timing mismatch, single-sample latency, instrumentation overhead, non-disjoint timing fields, and total-host-temporary ambiguity, attempt D still meets the explicit gate on the properties that decide admission: exact 8/8 correctness and a canonical measured reduction from 58x to 21.000762818351625x. Admit exactly one hardware-matched integrated v11 transaction under the mandatory conditions.
